name: minijinja_render
description: Render a MiniJinja template without a JSON context. For context values, particularly columns or json_object built from columns, use minijinja_render_with_context. Optional named arguments must be constant expressions.

name: minijinja_render_with_context
description: Render a MiniJinja template with a JSON context, including contexts built from columns with json_object. Supports variables, filters, conditionals, for loops and autoescaping. Optional named arguments such as autoescape must be constant expressions.

examples.code: SELECT minijinja_render_with_context('{% for x in xs %}{{ x }}{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}', '{"xs":["A","B","C"]}');
